topic_text.status: what they are studying now, their class, group or year
topic_text.history: their education so far: the qualification, group and marks they have
topic_text.interests: which subjects they like and are good at
topic_text.family_social: what their family wants them to study
topic_text.values: what matters most to them when they choose a field of study
topic_text.strengths: which subjects or study tasks they do well in
topic_text.pressures: their budget range for study and whether they can move to another city
topic_text.sure: how sure they feel about the field they lean toward, on a scale from 0 to 10
topic_text.goals: the field of study they lean toward and why
topic_text.options: the fields of study and entrance tests (ECAT, MDCAT, NAT, SAT) they are considering
